hooks.command: input=$(cat) || { echo 'The review gate could not read the hook input, so the command is refused.' >&2; exit 2; }; case "$input" in *gh*pr*create*|*gh*pr*new*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/packages/review" && printf '%s' "$input" | mix review gate; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 2 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi; echo 'The review gate (mix review gate, in packages/review) failed to run, so the pull request is refused. Fix the error above and try again.' >&2; exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that this change was reviewed

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/packages/review" 2>&1 && { mix compile >/dev/null 2>&1; mix review plugins 2>&1; }; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that this machine holds the pinned plugins
